scope: Main React workspace business requests; local production image, PostgreSQL, S3, worker, renderer and antivirus

before.cookies: Second synthetic teacher; the first teacher's settings form was still visible

implementation.client: Stable per-owner AccountClientProvider; useAccountApi/useAccountClient in all React business consumers and useServerDraft
implementation.server: Authenticated session remains authoritative; mismatching explicit intent gets 409 SESSION_CHANGED before business data/body work
implementation.recovery: Canonical session refetch with no automatic mutation replay
implementation.uploads: Multipart, signed-upload initialization and completion use the captured owner; storage PUT retains its separate signed URL contract
implementation.legacy: Absent hint preserves existing session authorization; old clients therefore lack the new stale-UI defense

limits: Native Better Auth password, session-revocation and sign-out commands require separate intent fencing
Lite account observation and intent binding require a separate lightweight implementation
Older clients without the hint retain cookie-only intent semantics; ownership authorization remains enforced
Already committed mutations are not rolled back
Real cloud proxy forwarding and multi-user school load remain unverified
The later native-auth extension requires its own completed remote CI run; no public hosting or paid resources were created
